question: amasai is recorded with more than one father: elkanah, elkanah-4.
note: The Hebrew chain in 1CH 6:35–36 distinguishes Elkanah son of Mahath from Elkanah son of Joel, father of Amasai; protected owner row 107213 assigns the former relationship to the latter record and cannot be changed. 1CH 6:25 does not identify Elkanah's father, so it alone cannot resolve the competing father links; protected owner rows 105596 and 105603 also remain untouched.
